title: The Match to Kill
overview: A documentary investigation dives into the violent wrestling rivalry between Gia Savitz and Frankie Firestarter, uncovering hidden footage tied to a disturbing series of events. What begins as an exploration of betrayal, obsession, and underground wrestling culture slowly transforms into something far darker as the filmmakers uncover secrets neither competitor wanted exposed. Blending true-crime style storytelling with psychological suspense, The Match to Kill explores how hatred, trauma, and revenge can spiral beyond control.
